Curry Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 10:48pm

Ingredients




1 can cream of chicken soup, (10 ¾ oz.)
1 medium apple
cup seedless raisins
cup milk
2 teaspoons curry powder
9 pieces fried chicken

Preparation

1 In a medium bowl, combine all ingredients except chicken. 2 Place chicken in a single layer in a 8"x12" baking pan. Cover chicken with sauce. Bake, covered in preheated 350 degree oven for 30 minutes. 3 Continue baking uncovered for 30 minutes longer.
